provenance: Original content — Hollow Lantern Guild, © 2026 Example Campaign
note: A supply catalogue and nothing else: one section, six items, no creatures or spells. Every use is a heal or a damage roll, so the pack loads unchanged with the bundled slice excluded.

items.name: Hollow Lantern Restorative
items.description: The guild's standard issue. Tastes of pitch and closes a wound anyway.

items.name: Hollow Lantern Oil Flask
items.description: Lamp oil in thin glass, lit at the wick before it is thrown.

items.name: Guild Smelling Salts
items.description: Snapped under the nose of someone who has stopped paying attention.
unmodelled: Also ends a magical sleep effect; the engine does not model sleep

items.name: Wick-Cutter's Acid
items.description: Kept for locks and hinges. It works on people too.
unmodelled: Ruins one nonmagical metal object it is poured over

items.name: Guild Field Tincture
items.description: The cheap one. Half a dose of the restorative at a third the price.

items.name: Lamplighter's Signal Charge
items.description: Meant to be heard three streets away. Held too long, it is a weapon.
unmodelled: Audible for half a mile, which is the point of carrying one
